![plugins](https://misc.framerstatic.com/plugins/plugins-readme-asset.png)

Plugins in [Framer](https://www.framer.com/) are small apps that extend Framer, enabling you to sync content into the CMS, insert Components, modify any layer, and much more. Check out our [Marketplace](https://www.framer.com/marketplace/plugins/) to see a selection of Plugins, or visit our [Plugins](https://github.com/framer/plugins) repo to see working code examples. Learn how to build your own with our [documentation](https://framer.com/developers/plugins).
